press_references.value: NBB and INJAZ Bahrain Celebrate Emerging Entrepreneurs at Entaliq Closing Ceremony

partnership_announcements.description: National Bank of Bahrain and INJAZ Bahrain continue their Entaliq with INJAZ entrepreneurship programme collaboration, providing mentorship and support for student-led ventures focused on sustainability, technology, accessibility, and community impact.

press_references.value: NBB participates in tree-planting event marking World Environment Day-

partnership_announcements.description: National Bank of Bahrain collaborated with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development on a World Environment Day tree-planting event at Isa Town Walkway, reinforcing their ongoing partnership on local afforestation and environmental awareness.

press_references.value: NBB joins forces with BLME to provide UK property loans

partnership_announcements.description: National Bank of Bahrain and Bank of London and The Middle East signed a strategic collaboration to offer Sharia-compliant UK property finance solutions to NBB’s high-net-worth clients, giving them access to BLME’s regulated residential, investment, and buy-to-let financing offerings across the UK.

press_references.value: NBB Concludes “Yalla Learn and Earn” Campaign with Masterclass Workshop for Students

partnership_announcements.description: National Bank of Bahrain concluded its "Yalla Learn and Earn" campaign, delivered in partnership with INJAZ Bahrain and supported by the Ministry of Education to promote financial literacy and digital banking skills among secondary school students.

press_references.value: NBB and Fab Lab Bahrain Launch Second Edition of TechStride to Empower Future Innovators

partnership_announcements.description: National Bank of Bahrain (NBB) and Fab Lab Bahrain have announced the launch of the second edition of TechStride, an educational initiative aimed at empowering young Bahrainis with practical knowledge in emerging technologies.

press_references.value: NBB Signs Strategic Agreements with Leading Real Estate Developers During Innovation Summit in Social Housing 2025

partnership_announcements.description: The National Bank of Bahrain (NBB) signed five strategic Memorandums of Understanding with ERA Real Estate, Kayan Real Estate, Delmon Gate, Best Location Properties, and Al Janabiya Gate during the Innovation Summit in Social Housing 2025. These partnerships aim to provide social housing beneficiaries with expanded property options and streamlined financing solutions, supporting national housing ambitions in Bahrain.

press_references.value: Turning Eid Gifting into a Digital Saving Experience NBB Introduces Yalla Eidiya Pocket Through its Yalla Family Banking Proposition

product_launches.description: National Bank of Bahrain launched the Yalla Eidiya Campaign and its associated Yalla Eidiya Pocket savings wallet within the NBB app, a digital feature under the Yalla Family Banking proposition that lets families set up dedicated Eid-themed savings pockets for children and enter a raffle.

press_references.value: National Bank of Bahrain Provides “Eidiya” New Banknotes Through ATMs and Branches

product_launches.description: National Bank of Bahrain launched a seasonal 'Eidiya' service offering new Eid banknotes via six ATMs and fourteen branches across Bahrain from 17 March 2026 while stocks last, to improve customer convenience during the holiday period.

press_references.value: NBB Launches Premium Mastercard Campaign for Jewellery Week Bahrain 2025

about_short_description.short_description: National Bank of Bahrain BSC is a provider of retail and wholesale commercial banking, treasury and investment.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Personal banking services including current and savings accounts, deposits, consumer loans, mortgages, payment cards, and digital banking for individuals.

product.name: Corporate and Commercial Banking
product.description: Banking solutions for businesses and institutions, including accounts, lending, working-capital finance, trade services, cash management, and payment solutions.

product.name: Treasury Services
product.description: Foreign exchange, money-market, interest-rate, liquidity, and risk-management services for corporate, institutional, and investment clients.

product.name: Investment Banking
product.description: Advisory and capital-markets services supporting corporate finance, fundraising, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, and investment transactions.

product.name: Wealth Management and Investment Services
product.description: Investment and portfolio services for affluent individuals, family offices, institutions, and other investors seeking to manage and grow assets.

product.name: Trade Finance
product.description: Import, export, and supply-chain financing services, including letters of credit, guarantees, documentary collections, and related transaction support.
